meta.title: Nexia — Cross-Server Game Companion · Real-Time Danmaku Translator
meta.description: Real-time in-game chat translation for League of Legends. Capture chat, translate instantly, display as danmaku overlay. Nai-nai, your cross-server translation companion.

hero.imageAlt: Nai-nai waving on a game screen with danmaku translations gliding across
hero.eyebrow: LoL Cross-Server Companion · Real-Time Danmaku Translation
hero.titleAccent: Language is no longer a wall.
hero.body: Nexia captures every line in your game chat, translates it in real time, and displays it as stylish danmaku gliding across your screen. No alt-tabbing to Google Translate. Stay focused. Win the game. NEXIA Expresses Cross-language Interactions Automatically.

capabilities.title: More than a translator — a teammate who's got your back.
capabilities.body: Behind every danmaku is Nai-nai typing at lightning speed — four-language simultaneous translation, gaming slang localization — she knows the game as well as you do.

items.title: Ultra-low Latency · Near-zero Perception
items.body: The moment a chat message appears, the translated danmaku is already on screen. Built on Tauri + Rust with minimal memory footprint — never costs you a single frame.

items.title: Danmaku Overlay · Stays Out of the Way
items.body: Translations glide across the screen as semi-transparent danmaku. Font size, speed, and color are fully customizable. Never blocks the minimap, never interrupts teamfights.

items.title: Gaming Slang, Localized
items.body: More than literal translation. Korean 'ㅋㅋㅋ', Japanese 'wwwww', English 'diff' — Nai-nai converts them into expressions you instantly understand, complete with the right tone.
items.note: KR / JP / EN / FR → Chinese + more

workflow.title: Install. Configure. Play. That's it.
workflow.body: Nexia runs as a lightweight Tauri desktop app. Auto-detects your LoL client — danmaku translation is ready to go the moment you are.

steps.title: Download & Install
steps.body: Grab the installer for your platform from GitHub Releases. One-click setup.

steps.title: Pick Your Languages
steps.body: Set source and target languages. Tweak danmaku style — size, speed, colors are all yours.

steps.title: Launch the Game
steps.body: Start your LoL client. Nexia auto-detects the game process and activates automatically.

steps.title: Real-Time Translation
steps.body: Every foreign chat message instantly becomes text you can read, gliding across your screen with a neon glow trail.

steps.title: Adjust on the Fly
steps.body: Hotkeys to switch languages, toggle danmaku, adjust opacity — never interrupts your gameplay or vision.

steps.title: Focus on Winning
steps.body: No more alt-tabbing to translate. Nai-nai handles all communication. You just focus on the game and win.

principles.title: Tauri 2.0 Desktop Framework
principles.body: Rust backend + Web frontend. Small installer, low memory, instant launch.

principles.title: Rust Performance Core
principles.body: OCR text capture and translation requests all handled on the Rust side — zero overhead.

principles.title: Canvas / WebGL Danmaku Rendering
principles.body: GPU-accelerated overlay rendering. Smooth 60fps danmaku, never stutters.

principles.title: Full Cross-Platform Support
principles.body: Windows · macOS · Linux. One codebase, consistent experience.

architecture.graphAriaLabel: Game chat → OCR capture → Translation engine → Danmaku rendering → Screen overlay display
